## Landed

**CELL-SPEC (AR-06, ADR-0428):**
- `hh-helper`: `CellSpec` on `PodmanBackend` + flags `--workdir`,
  `--workdir-from-image` (image inspect, absent WORKDIR refuses exit 3),
  `--cpus`, `--memory`; verbatim `--cpus`/`--memory`+`--workdir` in the
  create argv; undeclared ⇒ byte-identical (AC-2 leg pins the full argv).
  Verbs: `cp_in`/`cp_out` (`/work` alias refuses before argv), `exists`,
  `ls_dir`, `rm_glob`, `terminate_group` (TERM→KILL); `HH_PODMAN_BIN`.
- `hh-env::cell_spec`: `ext["cell_spec"]` strict decode →
  `EnvHandle.cell_spec` → `start_helper` appends `helper_args()`;
  `task_image_ref` — `name@sha256:<hex>` → `ForeignDigest` + platform +
  R1; tag-only refuses.
- `hh-runner::cell`: `CellOps` seam + `PodmanCell` + `run_cell` ST1–ST5 —
  `/tests`/`/solution` absent until phase, copy-in only, stale `reward.*`
  removed before each verify leg, execs under declared WORKDIR.

**DEADLINE (AR-07, ADR-0429):**
- `hh-env::task_deadline`: `task_declared_deadline_ms` (declared ×
  multiplier under protocol ceiling; above-ceiling/malformed refuse),
  `admit_task_deadlines` (transactional, `ext["deadline_admission"]`),
  `task_deadline_echo`. Legacy `verifier_deadline_ms` untouched — r5_57
  13/13 unchanged.
- Worker ST0: `task.deadlines` → enforced per-phase values or
  `withheld{admission:deadline_admission}`; cell drive terminates the
  agent process group on lapse → `end_cause: agent_timeout` + ST5 runs.

**VERDICT:**
- `hh-runner::verdict`: `harbor_reward_file/1` — `HarborRewardExecutor`
  implements `OracleExecutor` for `OracleRunner` (shared isolation,
  `tamper: n/a{no_detector}`; `grade`/`parse_typed_reward` unchanged);
  §3.4 rules 1–6 (json preferred, exactly-one-numeric, multi-key →
  `reward_json_multi_key`; txt decimal [0,1] ≤6 digits → exact ppm;
  missing/unparseable typed); verbatim bytes in `verdict.files`.
- Bootstrap classifier `classify(files, mediator_rows, timed_out)` — pure:
  egress_denied / upstream_error / signature ⇒
  `verifier_unavailable:bootstrap:*`; no evidence ⇒ scored 0 +
  `infra_suspected:verifier_no_report`; ctrf present ⇒ scored;
  reward=1 + ctrf failures ⇒ `reward_ctrf_inconsistent`; timeout ⇒
  `verifier_timeout`. Mediator taken as fixture rows (lands R6.15; the
  fault-injection leg is owed to R6.17 build + R6.32 run).
- Same-cell regrade bound (`max_attempts=2`); participant never re-run.
- `tb10_pytest_log/1`: committed `strip_ansi` set + PytestParser-
  equivalent short-summary parse; `select_channel` confines it to
  `terminal-bench-core==0.1.1` — TB 2.1 refuses.
- `probe.rs`: `hh-targeted-probe/1` driver citing
  `grid-pattern-transform` + `swe-bench-langcodes`,
  `probe_execution: owed{row:R6.32,window:W1}` — never claims execution.
